dialogues.speaker: Qingye
dialogues.text: It's my first time doing something like this in someone else's clothes. It feels pretty good. I wouldn't mind doing it again...

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Something like what? Is there something wrong with you in the head?

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: We only went undercover for a day, and you're addicted already...?
